ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a benchmark workload, sample count and the single-sample flag are declared; it does not run benchmarks.
offer: Benchmark a named workload with enough repeated samples to characterize variance. A single timing measurement cannot support a regression or optimization claim.

minimal.reason: Name the workload benchmarked. A benchmark of an unspecified input cannot be compared, so describe it.

mid.reason: Take at least 30 samples. Fewer cannot characterize variance, so declare the sample count.

maximal.reason: Set concluding from a single sample to false. One timing cannot support a regression or optimization claim, so compare distributions.

rule.reason: Name the workload benchmarked. A benchmark of an unspecified input cannot be compared, so describe it.
